newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Internet child porn gets Swiss woman sentenced.
newsitem.headline: Internet child porn gets Swiss woman sentenced.

text.p: A Swiss woman who sent a friend pornographic pictures of child sex from the United States via computer was sentenced on Monday in Switzerland's first such case of Internet-aided crime.

A court in Lausanne handed the 33-year-old woman, who has lived in the United States since 1993, a 15-month suspended sentence for sending her friend around 10 paedophile pictures, the SDA news agency reported.
The unnamed woman was not in court for the sentence.
The case emerged when investigators probing software piracy seized computers from the friend and discovered the pictures. They used e-mail records to track down the woman.
